default_for: Future Chuyện Thương Hiệu campaign-analysis videos unless explicitly overridden
text_spacing: Natural font spacing; never justify or stretch word spacing
text_wrapping: Balance the line widths and fill the safe title box while preserving natural phrases and left alignment. Fit by word breaks and a naturally wider or narrower face in the same family, without tracking or justification.

hook.footage_choice: Climax or distinctive creative action from the original video
hook.scaling: Uniform cover; crop deliberately to keep the main subject and action visible
hook.edge_blend: Preserve the frame alpha fade into orange
hook.duration: Follow the approved hook narration and current user request; not fixed
hook.logo: Use only the logo already embedded in the frame

body.foreground: Sharp image at its original aspect ratio, spanning the full canvas width for landscape sources
body.background: Blurred version of the same footage above and below the landscape foreground

logo.visibility: Immediately after hook until video end

editing.avoid: Unintended flashes of native title cards or next shots at source excerpt boundaries
editing.readability: Hold each continuous shot through at least one complete spoken sentence. Do not use rapid montage in the hook unless explicitly requested.
editing.local_fixes: Trim, hold, or gently slow footage as needed without shifting approved narration or captions
editing.qa: Inspect the actual exported video at cuts, hook end, titles, logos and narration-caption sync. Verify sharp landscape footage reaches both canvas edges on representative body scenes. Check protected content against the supplied safe-area polygon, including text outlines and diacritics. Hide the guide in exported video.
editing.minimum_shot_hold: At least one complete spoken sentence before any visual cut, including hook. Cuts belong in the silence after sentence endings; a shot may span multiple sentences.
editing.source_internal_cuts: Check and avoid native camera cuts inside a selected excerpt during a spoken sentence; select continuous footage long enough for the narration.
